name: GenCode Usage
description: Shows GenCode (Genspark) token/cost usage and credit pool tier (GREEN/YELLOW/RED/EXHAUSTED) in the Orca status bar and sidebar panel, locally or over SSH.

settings.title: SSH host (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty to run gencode locally. Set an SSH config alias or user@host to read gencode stats from a remote Linux server.

settings.title: GenCode CLI path
settings.description: Executable name or absolute path for the gencode CLI (on the target host).

settings.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the worker polls `gencode stats` in the background.

settings.title: Daily cost budget (USD, optional)
settings.description: When no manual credit balance is set, compute status bar percentage from today's cost against this USD budget (0 disables).
